title: HarfBuzz avar2 zero-width variation rows can amplify subset memory
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not identified for this discovery)
summary: A small font with many avar breakpoints and a 65,535-row region-less VarData caused dense tuple allocation; the maintainer reports a 20 KB input reaching 2.8 GB peak memory.
ai_role: The primary maintainer commit explicitly says “Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-3HO8JDDV.” It separately lists Claude Opus 4.8 as a commit co-author; the source does not establish that model as the discovering system or describe its investigative steps.
classification_note: The maintainer source explicitly calls this a vulnerability and describes resource exhaustion from crafted font inputs in the subset path. It does not report exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The maintainer commit documents a separate budget for avar2 tuple-memory deltas, rejecting the subset cleanly on exhaustion; it also reports the attack reproducer reduced from 2.8 GB to 21 MB. The commit does not establish an affected or fixed release boundary.

impacts.conditions: A crafted font supplied to avar2 subsetting can drive excessive memory allocation; maintainer reports 2.8 GB peak memory from a 20 KB input.
impacts.exploitation: The cited maintainer source reports resource consumption from crafted test inputs; it does not report exploitation in the wild.
